682:t_1:83.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are you saying the $$御使い$$s abandoned $$サイデリアル$$, which serves under them?」

682:t_1:84.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Judging by the situation, that seems to be the case.」

682:t_1:85.en:
$$シンジ$$
「With their forces... we could fight even the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

682:t_1:86.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't rely on bastards like them. We'll open a path to the future with our own strength.」

682:t_1:87.en:
$$勝平$$
「Sis $$ノリコ$$'s world beat the $$宇宙怪獣$$ too! Let's do it ourselves!」

682:t_1:90.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...The scale of these $$宇宙怪獣$$... is far greater than the ones in our world.」

682:t_1:92.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Judging from their territory and distribution, I think they're more than five times the scale of those in our world.」

682:t_1:93.en:
$$トライア$$
「...There's no point in offering false comfort. I'll put up the footage the reconnaissance fleet sent us.」

682:t_1:98.en:
$$トライア$$
「As you can see, they're $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

682:t_1:99.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So all those areas that look like blotches are swarms of them.」

682:t_1:100.en:
$$シャア$$
「They fill over 80 percent of the view... Even ten billion would be an underestimate.」

682:t_1:102.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「If we lose to them, it won't just be humanity... the entire universe will be finished...」

682:t_1:107.en:
$$アルト$$
「We knew this would be a hard fight before we even left Earth.」

682:t_1:108.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm not about to get cold feet now.」

682:t_1:109.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah...! If losing means the end, we'll just have to literally put our lives on the line.」

682:t_1:110.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... I have to move forward... That's all I can do...」

682:t_1:111.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Everyone in the $$ボランティア部$$ is so strong.」

682:t_1:112.en:
$$スズネ$$
「They've kept fighting of their own free will, even without any reward. I think that spirit is carrying them through now.」

682:t_1:113.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...That hits a little too close to home...」

682:t_1:114.en:
$$トライア$$
「You ruin the whole moment just by being here.」

682:t_1:115.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...As for our operation to annihilate the $$グレートアトラクター$$... the $$宇宙怪獣$$' nest...」

682:t_1:116.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The first phase is to advance the new Buster Machine No. 3 as close as possible to the galactic center, where they appear.」

682:t_1:117.en:
$$トライア$$
「Then we'll activate the $$時空震動弾$$.」

682:t_1:118.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet and our allies, including the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$, will hold back the surrounding $$宇宙怪獣$$, but enemies will still get through.」

682:t_1:119.en:
$$シャア$$
「Our mission is to hold the new Buster Machine No. 3's final defensive line at all costs for the seven minutes between activation and detonation.」

682:t_1:120.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The future of every parallel world rests on this operation...」

682:t_1:121.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Forgive me... I ask you all to give your lives.」

682:t_1:122.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't need to apologize, Captain $$ブライト$$.」

682:t_1:123.en:
$$シン$$
「We've... already made up our minds.」

682:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But I don't plan on dying. I want to welcome the future with $$ティファ$$.」

682:t_1:125.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're different from the force that seeks to vanish. Let's see the new era... the future, with our own eyes.」

682:t_1:126.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You're right. Then let me put it another way.」

682:t_1:127.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I order everyone to return alive! We'll protect the future and make it home alive!」

682:t_1:131.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It's all right, $$ノノ$$. Princess will definitely come...」

682:t_1:132.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Exactly. Fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is $$フラタニティ$$'s duty and the $$バスターマシン$$s' mission.」

682:t_1:134.en:
$$カズミ$$
「The Galactic Raid Fleet's second wave, with $$ラルク$$ and the others, will surely help us.」

682:t_1:135.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Until then, let's do our best with our own strength!」

682:t_1:138.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$... wanted to be like you, $$ノリコ$$...」

682:t_2:3.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$ダイバスター$$ stopped the Earth... $$ドゥーズミーユ$$!」

682:t_2:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「Look! The ether-current accelerator that brought the Earth all this way is transforming into a humanoid shape!」

682:t_2:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Is that Princess's $$トップレス$$ power?!」

682:t_2:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Move, No. 7!! Stay out of my way!!」

682:t_2:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I won't rely on someone like you when I don't even know where you came from! This is humanity's fight!」

682:t_2:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Humanity will survive, even if we have to throw the Earth away! I don't know if it's right...! You have nothing to do with this!」

682:t_2:10.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... You don't even know how I feel...! You...!!」

682:t_2:12.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You only had to stay my friend! I wanted you to call me $$ラルク$$, instead of Big Sis!」

682:t_2:13.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But you...! You kept getting stronger all on your own, and left me behind...!」

682:t_2:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I... can't be the person you admire! I can't be $$ノノリリ$$!」

682:t_2:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ can't become $$ノノリリ$$ either...」

682:t_2:19.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$... wanted to be like Big Sis... $$ノノ$$ was always jealous of you...」

682:t_2:20.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Because... Big Sis is so much like $$ノノリリ$$...」

682:t_2:22.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$ isn't someone special... She's an ordinary girl...」

682:t_2:23.en:
$$ベック$$
「Tsk, tsk, tsk... You've got it wrong, little lady.」

682:t_2:24.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$! Why are you here?!」

682:t_2:25.en:
$$ベック$$
「Why? Because I'm part of the Galactic Raid Fleet's second wave too.」
